result.title: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
result.summary: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts backbone with approximately 9B parameters in each branch, UniSpark combines full attention for explicit token interactions with GatedDeltaNet linear attention for compact context propagation. Autoregressive text prediction and visual flow matching jointly support visual question answering, text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and interleaved text-image prediction. In interleaved generation, noisy visual targets are isolated from subsequent predictions, while clean visual representations provide context for later outputs. A blockwise protocol enforces this distinction through attention masks in full-attention layers and recurrent-state retention rules in linear-attention layers. The selected training sources contain 159.7M generation samples, 213.4M understanding samples, and 624.8K interleaved sequences. A four-stage curriculum jointly trains multimodal understanding and visual generation, refining answer accuracy and instruction following while extending image synthesis to 2K. UniSpark scores 2470.3 on MME-S and 0.83 on GenEval. Qualitative examples further illustrate its capabilities in interleaved image generation, video synthesis, and video editing. Together, these results demonstrate that hybrid attention provides an effective backbone for unified multimodal understanding and generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UniSpark-9B 统一多模态模型，在 Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts 主干中混合 full attention 与 GatedDeltaNet 线性注意力，联合 AR 文本预测与视觉 flow matching，支持问答、文生图、指令编辑与交错图文生成，并用分块注意力掩码隔离噪声视觉目标与干净视觉上下文。
AI.relevance_reason: 其线性注意力的循环状态保留规则与分块掩码「噪声目标/干净视觉上下文」分离协议，可供核查压缩内部状态如何保留视觉证据、避免目标信息泄漏到推理状态，但与 latent 推理本身无直接关系。
